newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-United Int says has 50,000 homes.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-United Int says has 50,000 homes.

text.p: United International Holdings Inc, the regional franchisee of pay TV operator Australis Media Ltd, said on Monday it had 50,000 homes on its regional service and was in negotiations with Optus Communications to purchase a satellite service.
United International's regional vice-president, Don Hagans, said the service would also change its name to AUSTAR from CETV (Communications Entertainment TV).
The talks with Optus Communications were not in any way linked to the company's ongoing discussions with other investors about the future of Australis.

"A service on the Optus satellite system would give us the independance and resources to make even further inroads into Australian pay TV," Hagans said, citing the potential for iuncreased channel capacvity.
The AUSTAR service covers regional New South Wales, Queensland, Victoria, Souith Australia and the Northern Territory.
